title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning and extend RBAC v2 audit logging for key-bound resources. No API surface changes; existing config for KMS residency required for Private deployments.
description: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require guarantees that customer-managed KMS keys and data-residency constraints are enforced at the RBAC layer and surfaced in audit logs. This change tightens RBAC v2 semantics to associate KMS keys with region residency policies, ensures the control-plane emits structured audit events for KMS-bound operations, and adds validation to prevent cross-region key usage. Summary of changes: - RBAC v2: add new resource attribute `kms_region` and enforcement hooks in the permission evaluator. - Audit logging: emit structured events for KMS operations (create/attach/detach/use) including key ID, region, principal, action, request_id, and policy_version. - Validation: fail resource creation/update if provided KMS key region conflicts with organization residency constraints; add a migration path with an audit-only mode controlled by feature flag. - Tests & tooling: unit + integration tests covering evaluator, policy migration script, and e2e smoke tests in the private installer. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only until the operator flips `redwood.security.kms_residency.enforce=true` in the control plane config; the migration script can be run to surface violations. Checklist: - [x] Add kms_region attribute to RBAC schema and evaluator - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS ops - [x] Add validation for region residency conflicts (audit-only flag) - [x] Integration tests against private installer and dedicated deploys - [x] Docs and migration guide updated - [x] Security review completed Commits (high-level): - add(rbac): kms_region attribute and evaluator hooks - feat(audit): structured KMS audit events and schema - fix(deploy): validation in resource create/update path - test: add unit and integration tests for residency checks - ops: migration script and feature flag handling
